answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The onyx holds work receipts rather than names, so the violet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the quill of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
